from d7 import *
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def q(Dq,B):
    w=lv(Dq,B,3000)['q']; g=groups(w); e0=g[0][0]
    return [x-e0 for x,c in g]
def res(p):
    g=q(*p); return [g[1]-8480,g[2]-16305,g[3]-20360]
r=least_squares(res,[900,800],x_scale=[100,100]) if False else None
import numpy as np
# 3 eq 2 unknowns, but 4T1 quartets don't depend on C: least squares

print(r.x,r.fun,q(*r.x))
Dq,B=r.x
for C in (2800,3200,3600,4000,4400):
    o=lv(Dq,B,C); e0=o['q'][0]
    print(C,[(round(x-e0)) for x,c in groups(o['d']) if c==3 and abs(x-e0-21000)<4000])

def model(p,j):
    Dq,B,C=p; o=lv(Dq,B,C); g=groups(o['q']); e0=g[0][0]

    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r

import numpy as np
from d7 import *
sel=np.where(sz==0.5)[0]
Mtot=np.array([sum(so[i][0] for i in range(n) if (dets[k]>>i)&1) for k in sel])
Dq,B,C=889.6,915,3794
F2=B+C/7;F4=C/35
H=Dq*Md['cf']+49*F2*Md[2]+441*F4*Md[4]
w,V=np.linalg.eigh(H)
e0=lv(Dq,B,C)['q'][0]
R=np.exp(-1j*np.pi/2*Mtot)
i=0
while i<len(w):
    j=i
    while j<len(w) and abs(w[j]-w[i])<1e-3: j+=1
    chi=sum(np.vdot(V[:,k],R*V[:,k]) for k in range(i,j))
    if 3000<w[i]-e0<30000 or True: print(round(w[i]-e0),j-i,np.round(chi.real,2))
    i=j
